Reference

Releases

The most recent releases, newest first. This is the only page that names versions. Each version links to its GitHub release; the changelog in the repository has the full entry.

VersionDateHeadline
1.0.352026-11-18An opt-in merge when branch protection is unreadable; absolute local paths kept out of a goal's PR; the public docs site source.
1.0.342026-11-18/sigma-init --antigravity writes the managed AGENTS.md block; the Cursor hooks wording is corrected.
1.0.33 (no release page of its own)2026-11-15Acceptance criteria are append-only, closing a goal releases the goals waiting on it, and follow-ups join their goal as slices.
1.0.322026-11-13The in-goal follow-up limit is a setting, followups.max_added_slices, default 10.
1.0.312026-11-13A goal run honours a project's recorded known-flake exception, and a --land run's work survives its container.
1.0.302026-11-13The loop passes the merge stop line, a committed list cannot silence setup-critical checks, and follow-ups become a setting.
1.0.292026-11-13Cloud sessions no longer get the setup wizard question, a branch-protection 403 falls back, and /sigma-orchestrate plans a batch in waves.
1.0.282026-11-05A blocked goal is freed once its explicit blockers close, and a commit-signing outage is reported once in plain words.
1.0.272026-10-31The first cloud --land wave's fixes, and a guide and readiness check for a cloud burst.
1.0.262026-10-29The resource guard after the cloud-run release: a held verify keeps its measurement and a cold verify gets more than one worker.
1.0.0 to 1.0.252026-10-07 to 2026-10-29The first public release, then the Decision Rulebook, branch upkeep, the stored dependency map and Sigma Chain, the resource guard, and the first cloud runs.
Technical detail

Versions are patch bumps of the 1.0 line. The headlines above are short readings of the changelog, which also records what was measured and what was not for each change; the guides named whats-new in the docs folder cover upgrade effects. To check what you have installed, run /sigma-doctor.
